title: Brugada Presents Second Government Report to CDMX Congress
detail: On October 14 Clara Brugada delivered her Second Government Report before the Mexico City Congress in a solemn session, with each parliamentary group given five minutes for its position. Por Esto reported she planned to present four reforms on housing, justice and emotional well-being. The Congress review (glosa) runs October 20 to November 16, opening with Government Secretary César Cravioto on October 20 and Citizen Security Secretary Pablo Vázquez on October 22.
